messages:
Aisha: that closing slide with the lighthouse gif was peak 2026 😂
Tom: honestly that was the best visual metaphor all-hands has ever seen :clap:
Jay: can we make the lighthouse our official mascot? votes: :raised_hands: :raised_back_of_hand:
Riley: @Jay yes but only if it gets a tiny hardhat and a coffee mug sticker
Olga: I made a quick sticker mockup -> https://imgur.com/placeholder (low effort but vibe)
Sam_K: dropping this in #design for stealing permission :sweat_smile:
Aisha: poll: post-all-hands snack run — sweet or salty? reply with "sweet" or "salty"
Tom: salty
Jay: sweet (sourdough + jam forever)
Riley: salty but put me down for sour patch if it's an option :heart_eyes:
allhands-bot: Cheers to the new lighthouse mascot! :beers: (reacts :tada:)
Olga: also huge shoutout to @engineering for the demo — that latency drop was wild. deserved the drumroll. :drum:
Sam_K: pre-emptive tiny brag: I snuck confetti into the deck transition animation. you saw nothing. :innocent:
Aisha: someone please clip the lighthouse + hardhat moment and pin it 😅
memebot: posted "lighthouse_watching_servers.gif" in thread (link) :laughing:
Tom: quick logistics — anyone heading to the SF office after the all-hands for a mini celebration? 6pm?
Jay: maybe! depends if the snack score is high enough (I vote for cookies)
Riley: i'll be there, bringing questionable playlist choices 
Olga: I'll bring stickers that are actually good, not just wireframes :wink:
Sam_K: cookie bake-off stakes now set. winner gets honorary mascot hat (made of paper)
Aisha: tally so far: sweet 2, salty 2, ambiguous (sour patch) 1 — looks like we need a mixed bag :chips:
Tom: +1 for mixed bag. also can someone set a 6pm calendar invite for SF folks?
Jay: @Tom sent a calendar invite. RSVP please 
Aisha: thanks y'all — this was wholesome. see some of you IRL later! :hugging_face:
